title: Equipment list
excerpt: Here is a (partial) list of the equipment I use for astrophotography or visual observing. This list is updated as gear is bought/sold. A link to a detailed page is provided when available.
html:
Here is a (partial) list of the equipment I use for astrophotography or visual observing. This list is updated as gear is bought/sold. A link to a detailed page is provided when available.

Mounts
  • Takahashi EM-200 Temma II

Optics
  • Astro-Tech AT8RC 
  • Takahashi Sky90 II refractor
Cameras
  • QSI583wsg CCD camera, astrodon LRGB gen 2 filters, Ha 5nm
  • Canon Rebel xti
  • CCD Lab QHY5 (KWIQ Guider)
  • Phillips SPC900N (Webcam)
Lenses
  • Canon 50mm f1.4
  • Canon 20mm f2.8
Accessories
  • Moonlite motorized focuser with microstep
  • Kendrick anti-dew system with heater strips
  • Losmandy dovetails  
  • Astro-Tech field flattener (AT2FF)
  • Parallax rings (Sky90)
  • Takahashi focal reducer for Sky90.
  • Meade f6.3 focal reducer
  • Takahashi 7 X 50 finder
  • Canon tc-80n3 intervalometer
  • SkyFi with SkyVoyager on iPad and iPod Touch
Eyepieces
  • Pentax XW 7mm

  • Meade Series 4000 40mm
  • Meade Series 4000 25mm
  • Meade 6.3mm
Other


Gear sold (or traded)
  • William Optics Zenithstar 80ED APO
  • Takahashi FS78 refractor
  • Meade Lx90 GPS 8" f10 SCT
  • Meade Lx10 SCT
  • Astro-Tech 66ED
  • Meade DSI pro (guider)
  • Meade f3.3 focal reducer
  • ShoeString GPUSB (usb/ST4 port guiding interface)
  • William Optics 0.8X focal reducer
  • Modified Canon 40D (by Jacques Chagnon)
  • Hutech IDAS-LPS Clip-On filter
  • LX 200 classic mount
  • Meade Super Wedge
  • Meade 10" f6.3 SCT
  • Unfiltered Canon Rebel xsi
  • Losmandy dovetails and counterweights
  • Hutech IDAS-LPS Clip-On filter ( 2nd)
  • Astronomik H-a 12 nm Clip-On filter
  • Hutech AZM100 mount
  • JMI Motofocus for Takahashi focuser
  • ShoeString FCUSB (focus motor control interface)
  • Takahashi LE 2.8mm
  • Takahashi LE 12.5mm
  • William optics diagonal
  • Takahashi diagonal
